data.current_description: Search the web, news and places, read a page's content, or get an answer with sources. Actions search, news, places, scholar, shopping, images, videos and answer take query; scrape and similar take url. Providers: Serper, SerpApi, Exa, DataForSEO. Routes to one Endpoint per action; provider auto picks the first preferred Provider this key may run, a named provider forces it. The response is exactly the Run that POST /v1/runs returns — provider-native output, exact charge_usd, run_url; its provider, endpoint and input say which Endpoint served the call. Under auto, a Provider error, timeout or rate limit falls back to the next preferred Provider; a no-result answer does not. Each fallback hop is its own Run, visible in the runs list. Idempotency-Key is required and behaves exactly as on POST /v1/runs.

data.description_suggestion: Execute web research queries across search, news, places, scholar, shopping, images, videos, or answer modes. Accepts either a query string (for search-based actions) or URL (for scrape/similar actions). Automatically routes to the most appropriate endpoint and provider based on your key's policy. Returns a Run object containing provider-native results, exact USD charge, run URL, and provider/endpoint metadata. Supports automatic fallback to alternative providers on errors or rate limits. Requires Idempotency-Key header. Each fallback attempt creates a separate Run visible in the runs list.
